title: Deterministic Inductive Motor Inrush Currents (LRA) and Non-Coincident Load Stacking Benchmark Matrix
publisher: PowerLab Applied Clean Energy Research Group
standards_cited: NEMA Standards Publication MG 1-2021 (Motors and Generators)
IEEE Std 399-1997 (IEEE Recommended Practice for Industrial and Commercial Power Systems Analysis - Brown Book)
NFPA 70 National Electrical Code (NEC 2023/2026) Article 430 & Article 702

methodology.fl_amps_definition: Continuous full load running current at nominal system voltage (120V or 240V AC split-phase).
methodology.lra_definition: Locked Rotor Amperes measured at standstill (s=1.0 slip) during initial 50ms-150ms sub-transient period.
methodology.soft_start_mitigation: Calculated assuming solid-state dual-ramp thyristor soft starter reducing initial LRA by 68% (multiplier 0.32x).
